{{Quote|Still, even a duck has to be taught to swim.''"<br />"''What's a duck?|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="SWN">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'' novel]]</ref>}}
'''Ducks''' were a type of waterfowl that could be found on several different [[Planet/Legends|planets]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], notably [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

==Anatomy==
Ducks were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Bird/Legends|birds]] that evolved on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]],<ref name="databank" /> a planet in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAWGG">[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: Empire at War'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> They had broad and elongated bodies, with a relatively long neck and a broad bill. They also had two [[Limb/Legends|legs]] set far back on the body and a pair of short, pointed wings.<ref name="databank" /> At least one race of ducks had [[Color/Legends|brown]]-speckled plumage.<ref name="databank" /> They could be seen swimming on the [[Solleu River/Legends|Solleu River]], a river that ran through [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of Naboo.<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> Their planet was also home to other waterfowl species, the [[quadduck]]s and the [[Pelikki/Legends|pelikki]].<ref name="VDE">''[[Star Wars: The Phantom Menace: The Expanded Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

==Ducks in culture==
{{Quote|If we can't get the shield generator fixed, we'll be sitting ducks.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]]|<ref name="TPM" />}}
As ducks were widespread in the galaxy, they were incorporated in several idiomatic expressions in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]],<ref name="databank" /> including "sitting duck."<ref name="TPM" /> The ship known as the ''[[Dusty Duck]]'' was presumably also named for these animals.<ref name="dusty duck">{{DB|starship|dustyduck|Dusty Duck}}</ref> However, not all residents of the galaxy were familiar with ducks, especially in some of the provincial regions or on dry, arid planets of the galaxy, like [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Luke Skywalker curiously asked what a duck was.<ref name="SWN" />

[[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], a [[Otolla/Legends|Otolla]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gugan]],<ref>''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> was compared to a duck due his physical features.<ref>[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization]]</ref>

[[File:rubberduckbox.png|thumb|left|A container with 1 ton of rubber ducks stored in Ramsees Hed.]]
Duck made of [[Rubber/Legends|rubber]] were used as toys. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] there were several [[cargo container/Legends|cargo containers]] in the warehouses of [[Ramsees Hed]], bearing the [[Alliance Starbird]], marked with [[High Galactic/Legends|High Galactic letters]] that they contained each a [[Metric_ton/Legends|ton]] of "rubber ducks".<ref name="Star Wars: Dark Forces">''[[Star Wars: Dark Forces]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Duck.jpg|thumb|The "ducks" seen in ''Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace'']]
Ducks were first mentioned in the [[1976]] [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|pre-novelization]] of the 1977 film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], which was ghostwritten by [[Alan Dean Foster]].<ref name="SWN" /> They were given an entry in the now-defunct [[Databank (original)|Databank]] of [[StarWars.com]], which stated that ducks appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="databank" /> However, the birds seen in that movie were later [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] into pelikki, a related species, in ''[[Star Wars: The Phantom Menace: The Expanded Visual Dictionary]]''. Nonetheless, the visual dictionary still mentions the ducks as part of Naboo's wildlife, meaning that the old Databank entry remains valid for the most part.<ref name="VDE" />
